Finansowanie WIB/Polish Science Fund. PhD z biologii lub nauk pokrewnych, doświadczenie w transkryptomice i bioinformatyce. 9700-11300 PLN gross/miesiąc, 8 miesięcy z możliwością przedłużenia.

jobs.title: Medical Data Specialist – Clinical Data Management
jobs.description: Clinical Data Manager w międzynarodowej firmie medtech. Weryfikacja danych klinicznych, dokumentacja GCP/GDP, współpraca z Clinical Operations/Biostatistics/Regulatory. Excel, SAS, R, Python. BSc/MSc Biomedical/Life Sciences. Hybryda Warszawa, 12-miesięczna umowa przez Antal.

jobs.title: Data Scientist – mRNA Manufacturing & Technical Development
jobs.description: Design and deploy advanced ML and optimization solutions for mRNA manufacturing. Statistical modeling, Bayesian experimental design, constrained optimization, Monte Carlo simulations, Generative AI. Python, scikit-learn, AWS, Docker. PhD + 0-2yr or MSc + 5-8yr. Bioinformatics background preferred. 70% in-office Warsaw.

jobs.title: Vice President, Biostatistics and Programming
jobs.description: Strategic leadership of global Biostatistics and Programming function for CRO. Oversee NDA submissions, clinical programs, SAS/statistical tools, departmental SOPs. 15+ years experience, 7+ years line management. Remote Poland. Oncology and multiple therapeutic areas.

jobs.title: ML Software Engineer – Medical Research
jobs.description: ML tooling for modern medical research — transform prototype workflows into scalable production solutions. PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, MLOps, proteomics data processing, computer vision. Remote or Wrocław. UoP: 15 000–18 000 PLN/month, B2B: 130–150 PLN/h.

jobs.title: Data Scientist – mRNA AI Platform
jobs.description: Design and deploy ML and optimization solutions for mRNA therapeutics manufacturing. Bayesian experimental design, constrained optimization, Monte Carlo simulations, Generative AI. Python, scikit-learn, AWS, Docker. Bioinformatics background preferred. 70% in-office Warsaw.

jobs.title: Senior / Lead Data Analyst – R&D (Wildlife & Wind Energy)
jobs.description: Full analytics lifecycle for environmental monitoring systems on wind farms and airports. Python, SQL, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, plotly, scikit-learn, statsmodels. Time series, anomaly detection, signal processing. Hybrid Gdańsk. UoP/B2B 17-22k PLN.

jobs.title: Senior Data Science Consultant – Data Science & AI
jobs.description: Tworzenie i wdrażanie aplikacji AI z naciskiem na generatywną AI, modele językowe i wyszukiwanie wektorowe. Projekty transformacyjne dla największych organizacji. Python, PyTorch, HuggingFace, Azure, LLM. Hybrid Wrocław. 3–5 lat doświadczenia w ML/AI.

jobs.title: PhD Student – RNA Splicing & Structural Biology (SONATA BIS)
jobs.company: IIMCB Warsaw (International Institute of Molecular and Cell Biology)
jobs.description: PhD position (4 years) in mechanistic studies of U12-dependent splicing pathway. CRISPR/Cas9 cell engineering, proteomics data generation and analysis, AI-based protein-protein interaction screening, cryo-EM structural characterization of RNA-protein complexes, model building and refinement. MSc in biology/biotechnology/biochemistry required. 5500–6000 PLN net/month.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer – Precision Cancer Medicine
jobs.description: AI-driven Pharma-Tech company focused on precision cancer medicine. Build scalable data pipelines, GCP/AWS, ETL/ELT, data lake/lakehouse, Terraform, Python or Snowflake. US time overlap required (12–18 CET). Remote. UoP: 20 000–22 000 PLN/month, B2B: 160–175 PLN/h.

jobs.title: Data Analytics Leader – R&D (Wildlife & Wind Energy)
jobs.description: Build and lead data analytics team for AI/IoT systems protecting birds on wind farms and airports. Python, ML, data pipelines from environmental monitoring systems. Hybrid Gdańsk. 5+ years analytical/data science experience. Environmental data, computer vision.
